a.lede: Amazon-owned Ring is pushing into robotics with the launch of a home security drone and a rolling robot designed to patrol and protect businesses.
a.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot

b.lede: Amazon's roaming Ring Robotics devices will debut in late 2026 and early 2027.
b.title: Ring cameras go mobile as Amazon debuts AI-powered security drone and robot
